rows.title: Value to the cent
rows.defect: a fractional share's value is floored, so $61.725 is $61.72

rows.title: Shares in basis points, rounded
rows.defect: shares are floored

rows.title: No gain without every cost
rows.defect: the costs on file are netted against the whole value (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: VTI without Schwab's cost basis has no gain

rows.title: Half-up percent
rows.defect: the percent is formatted with toFixed on a binary fraction, so 10.35 is 10.3 (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: The statement cites its source
rows.defect: the statement drops its source and as-of (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: AAA's share says per Mock Brokerage, as of

rows.title: As of the older read
rows.defect: the newest account's time is given for the whole
rows.test: Fidelity and Schwab, as of Schwab's Oct 10 read

rows.title: The line is inclusive
rows.defect: the line is exclusive

rows.title: By asset class by default
rows.defect: with no grouping named, every holding falls in one undefined bucket

rows.title: The way back, not the way out
rows.defect: the trade sign is flipped

rows.title: Holdings outside the target count
rows.defect: buckets outside the target are left out
rows.test: bond with no target shows as a $1,450.00 sell

rows.title: Inclusive screen bounds
rows.defect: lte is read as less than

rows.title: Wash sales are out of the total
rows.defect: wash-sale-blocked losses are counted

rows.title: 30 days, inclusive
rows.defect: day 30 is outside the window
rows.test: a buy 30 days after washes the sale

rows.title: Long term by the calendar
rows.defect: more than 365 days is long term, so a year with Feb 29 is long (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: A partial sale's share of cost
rows.defect: the whole lot's cost is the basis

rows.title: Over the limit is said
rows.defect: an over-contribution is shown only as $0.00 of room (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: Room never below zero
rows.defect: room is not floored at zero

rows.title: Buy or sell, never guessed
rows.defect: any side other than buy is a sell (the bug found building this packet: "BUY" was a sell)
rows.test: "short" is refused, not restated as a sell

rows.title: An estimate cites its quote
rows.defect: any quote with a price gives an estimate, "(undefined, as of undefined)" (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a quote with no source gives no estimate

rows.title: A limit price is a limit order
rows.defect: the type defaults to market whatever the price (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: A positive quantity
rows.defect: only a missing or zero quantity is refused

rows.title: Older than a day is named
rows.defect: an account is stale only after a week

rows.title: No as-of is said
rows.defect: an account with no as-of reads like a current one (the bug found building this packet)

rows.title: At the line fires
rows.defect: the line is exclusive

rows.title: No as-of, no alert
rows.defect: a quote with no as-of is treated as fresh (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a quote with no time never fires

rows.title: A day, not two
rows.defect: quotes are fresh for two days
rows.test: a quote 24 hours and a second old is stale

rows.title: A drop is a move
rows.defect: only a rise is compared to the line

rows.title: The clock in words
rows.defect: the clock is printed as a number of days whatever it is: "within -12 days", "within 1 days" (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: "within 1 day", "today, the last day", "was 12 days ago"

rows.title: No stage, no crash
rows.defect: the stage is read without a default (the crash found building this packet)
rows.test: a rollover with no stage asks for it
